> 第9章 石中之剑（第1页）
随着女人的靠近，一直盯着李天走来。一阵阵香气被李天吸入鼻中。虽然很香，但是李天还克制得住。虽然只有十六岁的年纪李天，经历得也多，不是那种见了美女就走不动路的人。
上楼谈吧？不一会儿来到一个雅间。
女人缓缓开口，小兄弟是和我们天华阁做生意。不知道小兄弟有多少丹药或者其它东西？
李天也不再回答，直接掏出一颗丹药让女人检查，果不其然、女人一看很惊讶。十成十的极品丹药，虽然丹药不是很珍贵，但是十成十的却很少，而且都是极品。
你好小兄弟我叫林燕，你可以叫我燕姐。不知道小兄弟有多少这种丹药，我们天华阁全部要。
林燕看着那么多丹药。不知道的还以为他把人家宗门洗劫了，而天华阁最重要的是信誉，客人隐私从不泄露。也没问丹药的来历，一口价十五万金币，林燕开口道。
李天心想也就几万，想不到丹药那么值钱，也就没有讨价还价。
我还有其它东西，李天再次从空间戒指里拿出一个储物袋递了过去。
林燕看着储物袋里的东西，上百头妖兽、完整的，其中还有九阶的妖兽。还有上百玉瓶、不用想就是妖核，还有一些武器，被这样的场景也是惊了一下。
这些值个十万，总共二十五万。说着递过一个储物袋。
李天看了看，人生第一次那么有钱。也是满心欢喜。收好储物袋，李天便告辞。
就在这时林燕开口了？小兄弟且慢，说着掏出一枚令牌，黑耀金打造的。上面写着天华阁。小兄弟凭借此令牌可以到天华阁任何商会买东西打八折。售卖东西手续费减半，享有贵宾包间，不过小兄弟以后再有好的东西首先得考虑我天华阁。
李天听着林燕的讲述，也不矫情，本身都是交易，收好令牌出门了。
当李天走后，当事掌柜问到，小姐怎么送出那么贵的令牌。
林燕看了看老人，福伯你只看其表不看其内，你知道什么？听那稚嫩的声音听不出来吗？他还很年轻不满十八，那么年轻的人那么多东西要么是富贵人家要么是天才。看其黑袍遮身，显然不是让人知道他身份，那么他就是天才。而且比较特殊那种，还有，那么年轻你没看到吗？，他都没有挂着储物袋，东西一下就出来了。分明是拥有空间戒指。我看他和武神域那些天才都有可比性，而且是这穷乡僻壤之地出现的人。他还在成长阶段给予最大帮助，以后对我们有利，生意人要与利为主。以后他来了要好好招待，别怠慢了。
老人缓缓低下头，终于明白自己小姐为啥那么看重他了，那么多细节自己都没注意到，想到，然后转身出去了。
而林天呢下了楼心里一阵悸动，他缓缓从楼下看过去，一把剑插在石头里。他抚摸着剑身，那种强烈感觉更加激烈。
就在这时。老人站在李天身后问道，公子是看中了这把剑？

这把剑是也是别人买给我们的，我们也是研究了很久。拔不出来!也没人来买，每个人都看到好奇过，剑怎么插在石头里，可是都拔了试过都最后离开了，也没人要，所以放这里了。
这把剑多少金币？福伯李天开口问道，由于没有表明价格，所以李天不知道具体价格。
公子，我劝你别买了，这把剑没有什么用？锈迹斑斑的。你要更好的剑里面有。
福伯感叹了一句；也不再劝说，那你就给五千金币吧!李天也不犹豫，直接给对方了五千金币。把剑拿出，放储物袋里。

The latest chapter of The Great Emperor - Chapter 9 The Sword in the Stone Page 1 - How long can the Great Emperor go in the future - Hot Novel Network
> Chapter 9 The Sword in the Stone (Page 1)
As the woman approached, she kept staring at Li Tian. Waves of aroma were inhaled by Li Tian. Although it smells very good, Li Tian can still restrain himself. Although Li Tian is only sixteen years old, he has experienced a lot, and he is not the kind of person who can't walk when he sees a beautiful woman.
Let's talk upstairs? After a while, I came to a private room.
The woman spoke slowly, "The little brother is doing business with our Tianhua Pavilion." I wonder how many pills or other things my little brother has?
Li Tian stopped answering and took out a pill for the woman to check. As expected, the woman was surprised when she saw it. 10% of the best elixirs, although the elixirs are not very precious, but 10% of them are very few, and they are all of the best.
Hello little brother, my name is Lin Yan, you can call me Sister Yan. I don’t know how many of these elixirs my little brother has, but we at Tianhua Pavilion want them all.
Lin Yan looked at so many elixirs. Those who didn't know better thought he had robbed his sect, but the most important thing about Tianhua Pavilion was its reputation, and the privacy of its guests was never leaked. Without asking about the origin of the elixir, Lin Yan said, priced at 150,000 gold coins.
Li Tian thought it was only tens of thousands. He didn't expect the pill to be so valuable, so he didn't bargain.
I have other things. Li Tian once again took out a storage bag from the space ring and handed it over.
Lin Yan looked at the contents of the storage bag. There were hundreds of complete monsters, including ninth-level monsters. There were hundreds of jade bottles, demon cores, and some weapons. I was shocked by such a scene.
These are worth one hundred thousand, a total of two hundred and fifty thousand. He said and handed over a storage bag.
Li Tian looked at it. It was the first time in his life that he was so rich. Also full of joy. After putting away the storage bag, Li Tian left.
Just then Lin Yan spoke? Wait a minute, little brother, and as he spoke, he took out a token, made of black gold. It says Tianhua Pavilion. With this token, the little brother can get a 20% discount on shopping at any chamber of commerce in Tianhua Pavilion. The handling fee for selling things is halved, and you can enjoy VIP private rooms. However, if you have good things in the future, you must first consider me, Tianhua Pavilion.
Li Tian listened to Lin Yan's story without being pretentious. It was all a transaction. He collected the token and went out.
After Li Tian left, the shopkeeper asked why the lady gave away such an expensive token.
Lin Yan looked at the old man, "Uncle Fu, you only look at the outside but not at the inside. What do you know?" Can't you tell by that childish voice? He is still very young, not even eighteen years old. There are so many things about such a young person who either belong to a wealthy family or are geniuses. Judging from the black robe covering his body, it is obvious that he is not a genius if others know his identity. And it’s a special kind, and you’re so young, didn’t you see? , he didn’t even have a storage bag hanging on, and the things came out instantly. He clearly has a space ring. I think he is comparable to those geniuses in the Martial God Realm, and he is someone who appeared in this remote place. He is still providing the greatest help during the growth stage, which will be beneficial to us in the future. Businessmen should focus on profit. From now on, when he comes, you must treat him well and don't neglect him.
The old man slowly lowered his head, and finally understood why his lady valued him so much. He didn't notice so many details. He thought about it, then turned around and went out.
Lin Tian's heart palpitated when he came downstairs. He slowly looked downstairs and saw a sword stuck in the stone. He stroked the blade of the sword, and the intense feeling became even more intense.
Just then. The old man stood behind Li Tian and asked, did the young master take a fancy to this sword?
This sword was bought to us by someone else, and we have been studying it for a long time. It can't be pulled out! No one came to buy it. Everyone saw it and wondered why the sword was stuck in the stone, but everyone tried to pull it out and finally left. No one wanted it, so I put it here.
How much gold does this sword cost? Uncle Fu Li Tian asked, because he did not explainPrice, so Li Tian doesn’t know the specific price.
Young Master, I advise you not to buy it. This sword is of no use? Rusty. You want a better sword inside.
Uncle Fu sighed; he stopped trying to persuade him, so just give him five thousand gold coins! Li Tian didn't hesitate and gave the other party five thousand gold coins. Take out the sword and put it in the storage bag.
